message:
You know that moment when you finally feel like you’ve got your act together? 😌 Last weekend, we took some time to organize our go-bags and review our family emergency plans. It felt so satisfying to finally be the prepared ones when the neighbor popped over, asking if we had extra batteries for their flashlight. 

In that moment, instead of scrambling to help, we were ready to share — and it felt great! It’s a little reminder that being prepared doesn’t just help us; it allows us to support those around us too. Have you had a moment like that recently?
